author: ohtadmin
title: Comprehensive plan amendment meetings scheduled
text:
A public hearing on the proposed amendments to the Jamestown Comprehensive Community Plan has been scheduled for 6 p.m. Wednesday, Jan. 28.
A week before, at 6:30 p.m. Wednesday, Jan. 21, the planning commission will meet with the town council to present and discuss the amended plan. The hearing also will be a joint meeting.
“There is a requirement to hold a public hearing for both the planning commission and the town council,” Town Planner Lisa Bryer said. “The comprehensive plan has to have a public hearing by both bodies with approval by both bodies. So, the request to hold a joint public workshop and then a joint public hearing is just a way for everybody to be at the table at the same time. The planning commission is so familiar with the document that I think it will be helpful to have everybody in the same room.”
The comprehensive plan includes the implementation for an action plan, Bryer said, “which will guide actions of the community for the next decade.” The planners reviewed each element of that plan “at least twice” during this “tremendous undertaking.”
“I’m so happy to present you with this draft,” Bryer said. “It’s been 16 months of a lot of hard work.”
The state must approve the plan following adoption at the Jan. 28 hearing. If “substantive changes” are suggested by the state during its 165-day allotted review, an additional public hearing may be required, Bryer said.
The 406-page proposed plan, which was crafted with the consulting firm Weston & Sampson, can be reviewed at PlanJamestownRI.com.
